title: Test suite execution and static verification in services/mcp
answers: How do I run tests for services/mcp?
What test suites exist in services/mcp and which vitest configs do they use?
How do I typecheck and lint the MCP service?
body:
1. Fast unit tests: `pnpm --filter=@posthog/mcp run test` runs Node-pool tests in `services/mcp/tests/unit/` using `services/mcp/vitest.config.mts`.
2. Worker edge routing tests: `services/mcp/vitest.workers.config.mts` runs `services/mcp/tests/workers/` under Cloudflare's runtime via `@cloudflare/vitest-pool-workers`.
3. Hono server tests: `pnpm --filter=@posthog/mcp run test:hono` runs dispatcher, rate limiter, and session tests in `services/mcp/tests/hono/` using `services/mcp/vitest.hono.config.mts`.
4. Live integration tests: `pnpm --filter=@posthog/mcp run test:integration` runs `services/mcp/tests/tools/**/*.integration.test.ts` using `services/mcp/vitest.integration.config.mts` (requires `.env.test`).
5. Typecheck & lint: `pnpm --filter=@posthog/mcp run typecheck` (`tsgo --noEmit`), `pnpm --filter=@posthog/mcp run format` (`oxfmt`), `pnpm --filter=@posthog/mcp run fix` (`oxlint` + `oxfmt`), and `pnpm --filter=@posthog/mcp run lint-tool-names`.
